description: Potential null pointer dereference from unchecked malloc return
user_question: Is there any issue with this memory allocation code?
expected_root_cause: malloc can return NULL on failure; code dereferences without checking
expected_fix: Check malloc return value before using the pointer

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Add NULL check: if (!dst) return NULL;

expected_follow_up_required: Consider embedded context: malloc may not be available or may need custom allocator
